title: Clean Up Messy Customer Names
description:
`source_orders.customer_name` has inconsistent formatting — extra whitespace, inconsistent casing. Report the distinct set of customer names after trimming leading/trailing whitespace and lowercasing.

Name the column `customer`. Return the result in any order.
solutionSql: SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(customer_name)) AS customer FROM source_orders;
hint: TRIM only removes leading/trailing whitespace, not whitespace in the middle — that's enough here since the mess in this dataset is only at the edges and in casing.
outputExplanation: After trimming and lowercasing, the four distinct names are 'ann lee', 'ben kim', 'cy ortiz' and 'dee fox'. A hidden test shows that TRIM removes leading/trailing spaces from names like '  ben kim '.
